title: Verbos de disputa, refutación y réplica dialéctica
goal: Master verbs of dispute, refutation, and legal challenge (desmentir, refutar, impugnar, rebatir) in debate.
grammar: verbos de controversia dialéctica, refutación argumentativa y desmentido institucional

items: Distinguish between declaring falsehood (desmentir) and proving invalidity (refutar, rebatir).
Challenge the legal validity of acts and rulings using 'impugnar'.
Apply correct subjunctive mood following 'desmentir que' when truth value is rejected.
